shots.note: Ember eyes in a crack in the wall.

shots.text: A scout from the colony across the creek, hiding in our walls and counting us.
shots.note: The scout watches trap-jaws pass beneath it.

shots.text: I could have warned the queen, but who'd listen to number 250?
So I followed him home that night.
What I saw there wasn't a colony.
shots.note: The fire colony, glowing like embers.

shots.text: And they were all facing our way.
shots.note: Every one of them facing toward us.
